title: Crisp & Buttery
description: Short, high-fat doughs baked until sandy and crisp throughout -- butter (or ghee) is the whole point.

title: Soft & Chewy
description: American-style drop cookies with soft centers and just enough structure to hold together.

title: Filled & Sandwiched
description: Two layers built around a filling -- jam, dulce de leche, or a spiced nut-and-date paste.

title: Cookies Around the World
description: A quick tour of cookie traditions well outside the American drop-cookie default.

title: Tea & Coffee Companions
description: Restrained sweetness and a crumbly or crisp texture built to be dunked or paired, not eaten as dessert alone.

title: Holiday & Occasion Traditions
description: Cookies whose meaning is tied to a specific holiday or occasion, not just a flavor category.
